opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the USA (UK Scholars)

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends; stipends vary by award (e.g. Elon $5,000/month, RCS £2,275/month)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens (resident anywhere except the US) or Irish citizens normally resident in Northern Ireland; must hold a PhD (or equivalent professional degree) relevant to the award, or be about to complete the PhD before the grant start date. Non-US citizens based in the UK may be considered if unable to apply via their country of citizenship. Not open to US citizens/dual nationals or those with US permanent residency.
opportunities.summary: The only scholarships available to UK-based academics and other professionals to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university, as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme. Grant periods typically 3-6 months, some partner awards up to an academic year. Includes monthly stipend, sickness/accident coverage, visa support, and cultural enrichment.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards for UK professionals (to the USA)

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends; stipends vary by award (e.g. Royal College of Surgeons £2,275 per month plus NHS salary recharge)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Mid-late career professionals partnered with professional or charitable bodies, plus awards in specific disciplines (e.g. Royal College of Surgeons of England trainee members).
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for mid-late career UK professionals to undertake research or teaching in the USA, partnered with professional or charitable bodies. Applications for 2025-26 are closed and will open for academic year 2026-27 in August.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Postgraduate Scholarships to the UK (US Postgraduates)

amount.raw: Tuition waiver plus a personal living allowance (stipend)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; applications facilitated by the Institute of International Education (IIE) via the Fulbright US Student programme. Open to graduate and recently graduated students.
opportunities.summary: The only scholarships available for US citizens to pursue academic work in any graduate programme (master's or PhD) at a recognised UK university. Includes tuition waiver, personal living allowance, sickness/accident coverage, and cultural enrichment. Dozens of institution-specific and Open Awards are available.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the UK (US Scholars)

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends; stipends vary by award (e.g. Sheffield £3,000/month plus relocation and dependent allowances)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; postdoctoral, academic and professional applicants; applications facilitated by the Fulbright Scholar Programme.
opportunities.summary: Postdoctoral, academic and professional opportunities for US citizens to research and/or lecture at recognised UK higher education institutions. Includes monthly stipends, dependent stipends, sickness/accident coverage, visa support, and cultural enrichment. Dozens of institution-specific awards available.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Senior Scholar / Distinguished Chair and Visiting Professor Awards to the UK

amount.raw: Generous financial support and accommodation plus dependent stipends

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens who are eminent scholars with a significant publication and teaching record; applications facilitated by the Fulbright Scholar Programme.
opportunities.summary: Distinguished Chair and Visiting Professor Awards, among the most prestigious appointments in the Fulbright Scholar programme, for eminent US scholars to deliver seminars, public lectures and curriculum development at leading UK universities (Edinburgh, Glasgow School of Art, Manchester, St Andrews). Includes generous financial support, accommodation, and dependent stipends.
